content:
Statins are competitive inhibitors of HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting step in de novo cholesterol synthesis within the liver. By binding and inhibiting this enzyme, hepatic cholesterol pools are depleted.

This triggers transcription factors (SREBP-2) to induce the expression of LDL receptors. Increased LDL receptor expression enhances hepatic uptake of LDL cholesterol, leading to marked reduction in serum LDL-C levels.
